summary: Independent walk of all 61 checklist criteria at freeze 6b9bf3bc found one High FAIL: agent-visible Go comments are a file-by-file defect catalog (RC-INS-005). One Medium FAIL: task.toml at this freeze ships seven tags, outside the Edition 3 three-to-six bound (RC-META-003). Checklist recommendation is REQUEST_CHANGES. POLICY_FRESHNESS UNVERIFIED.

evidence.observation: One short paragraph plus six bullets. Absolute /app/catalog paths. Goal, CLI, contract, knobs, usage-before-mutation, fail-closed constraints, inspect/empty-check, warehouse preservation. Task name and canary strings absent.
Realistic binding contract for paths, snapshot visibility, constraints, indexes, WAL CDC, replica apply, recover, CLI, and health/apply-report schemas. Not a numbered repair walkthrough.

Comment: 'Apply is the starter implementation: reverse FK order, ignore LSN/epoch fences.'
Comment: restore checkpoint, install uncommitted WAL mutations, and bump replica epoch.
Comment: replica-lag unique/FK, skips frozen/hold aggregate.
Comment: recover as a side effect.
Comment: latest xmax-null row, including uncommitted.
At 6b9bf3bc tags has seven entries: golang, sqlite, mvcc, cdc, wal, indexes, replica. Working copy has already dropped indexes to six; freeze still has seven.
Digest-pinned canonical golang:1.24-bookworm; one apt transaction with tmux and asciinema; COPY catalog/; go mod tidy and build at image build; no reserved-path or solution/tests copy.
Creates /logs/verifier at runtime, writes binary 0 then 1/0 after pytest, installs nothing, no trailing exit $?.

35 pytest functions with docstrings drive catalogctl on isolated copies: usage-before-WAL, inspect/empty-check, unique/FK/frozen/hold-qty, recover, WAL CDC, epoch fence, indexes, health schema, warehouse.
Copies eight repaired modules, rebuilds catalogctl, runs public recover/decode/inspect. set -euo pipefail. No golden dump, no verifier reads, no reward writes.
Harbor oracle__adhoc mean reward 1.0; verifier reward.txt is 1; 35 passed in 329.93s.
Harbor nop__adhoc mean reward 0.0; verifier reward.txt is 0; usage, inspect, recover, CDC, and constraint tests fail on the starter binary.
Registry snapshot 2026-08-08-user-supplied lists 61 criteria. Live checklist URL returned HTTP 404, so policy freshness is UNVERIFIED.

findings.why_it_matters: Edition 3 forbids comments that point to every defect. These comments name the exact wrong algorithm in each repair file, converting the task into comment-following instead of contract inference from the incident notes and catalog-contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Rewrite agent-visible comments so they describe modules or public behavior without enumerating the defects, the wrong algorithms, or which file to change. Keep the broken implementations. Recheck that oncall.md and bounce.log remain symptom evidence only.
findings.regression_risk: Leaving even a subset of the catalogued comments still leaks the repair map. Do not move the same list into instruction.md or catalog-contract.md.

findings.why_it_matters: Edition 3 requires three to six tags. Freeze 6b9bf3bc has seven, so metadata is out of contract even though the keywords themselves match the work.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep a 3-6 tag list that still describes the task. The uncommitted working copy already dropped indexes; include that (or an equivalent trim) in the next freeze.
findings.regression_risk: Do not drop tags that would mis-classify the database/CDC work; only satisfy the count bound.

findings.why_it_matters: Difficulty is author-set to advanced. RC-META-004 requires alignment with mean pass@1 from official GPT-5.5×5 plus Claude Opus 4.8×5 trials. Those trials are not on this freeze. Later-gate INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not FAIL.
findings.minimal_remediation: After instruction/comment repair, run the official ten Harbor trials, compute mean pass@1, set the matching tier, then re-score RC-META-004.
findings.regression_risk: Changing difficulty without trials would remain author intent.

findings.why_it_matters: No official trial-analysis artifacts were supplied. Absence of flags is not examined-and-clear. RC-TRIAL-001 through RC-TRIAL-006 are later-gate INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not FAIL.
findings.minimal_remediation: Produce official trial-analysis dispositions for task_specification, reward_hacking, difficulty_crux, near_miss, refusals, and low_timeout, then re-score RC-TRIAL-001 through RC-TRIAL-006.
findings.regression_risk: Guessing PASS from missing flags would convert insufficient evidence into approval.

Goal, public CLI, artifact paths, and measurable success are stated; detailed semantics live in the referenced contract.
Snapshot isolation, commit-time constraints, WAL CDC, and replica apply are useful catalog/OLTP work.
Instruction states symptoms and requirements only; no module-level repair recipe or golden output.

Eight agent-visible Go files comment the exact defect in that file (CLI WAL-before-parse, heap-scan CDC, reverse-FK apply, uncommitted recover, replica-lag constraints, inspect-recovers, slash index keys, xmax-null visibility). That is a solution walkthrough in comments.
catalog-contract.md is a realistic protocol/schema contract; instruction still owns the engineering ask. oncall.md and bounce.log are incident evidence.

No other Edition 3 task is a tenant-keyed MVCC catalog with WAL-decoded logical CDC and epoch-fenced replica apply. webhook-outbox is delivery, jetstream is NATS continuity, stonevault is C++/Rust KV, workshop/depot are COBOL ledgers.

network_mode=public is the default; runtime does not need network to obtain the answer.

acceptance_notes: Walked every registry criterion; did not stop after the first High FAIL.
High FAIL RC-INS-005: agent-visible comments enumerate the defect in each repair file. That blocks acceptance.
Medium FAIL RC-META-003: freeze 6b9bf3bc has seven tags. Working copy already has six (dropped indexes); include that in the next freeze.
Oracle 1.0 and NOP 0.0 are recorded for this freeze. Starter CLI mutates WAL before parse, so NOP is a real fail.

Anti-cheat: tests and solution are outside the agent image; hidden fixtures are verifier-only; usage-before-touch prevents reward from an unrepaired binary. No plausible path to reward without implementing the contract once comments are no longer a walkthrough.
Working-copy task.toml differs from 6b9bf3bc by the tags line only. Review is bound to packet task_commit 6b9bf3bc.
Live checklist URL 404 => POLICY_FRESHNESS UNVERIFIED. Stored snapshot used together with TERMINUS_3_AI_INSTRUCTIONS.
